exposure.why: all current exposures opened in A3 (and bundled earlier)

permitted_inputs.name: SIMBAD proper motion +3981.977, -2466.832 mas/yr (Gaia EDR3)
permitted_inputs.used_for: visit-level systematic estimate (not a model input)

permitted_inputs.name: SIMBAD position and motion
permitted_inputs.used_for: identification gate and tangent-plane reference only

permitted_inputs.name: observer position: Earth (astropy built-in ephemeris) plus spacecraft header position
GM_sun and the speed of light

model.uncertainty: parameter covariance x max(1, reduced chi-square); for stars the larger of the exposure-level and the visit-level (per visit and array means) fit; plus sigma_sys from the scatter of per-visit-and-array mean residuals
model.notes: free parallax from SPHEREx alone was 0.369 +/- 0.014 arcsec vs 0.271 (A3, z = 7): visit-level systematics, so the catalogue value is fixed

baseline.description: straight-line motion in RA and Dec fitted to the same training positions, no parallax and no orbit

scoring.frame: tangent plane at the predicted position, east/north arcsec
scoring.observed: mean over identified holdout exposures of r_i = observed_i - model(t_i, observer_i), east/north arcsec in the tangent plane at the model position
scoring.c_obs: sample covariance of the r_i divided by N (N >= 3), never smaller than the mean per-exposure fit covariance divided by N
scoring.c_pred: frozen model covariance at the mean holdout time (parameter covariance scaled by max(1, reduced chi-square)) plus sigma_sys^2 per axis for the new visit's own offset
scoring.model_evaluation: the frozen model is evaluated at each identified holdout exposure's time and observer position (Earth plus the FITS header spacecraft position)

rules: A3 rules: quality gate; fit within 3 arcsec of the catalogue track; no other Gaia source within 12 arcsec
